    Maybe the most quaint and picturesque billiards hall in Tokyo. I could cycle to this one when it wasnt too hot and even won a small amateur three cushion competition there ~2010.

    This was the first club I tried playing three cushion billiards. What a revalation after years of only ever knownig snooker this game blew my mind - the die was cast, I was hooked. Many thanks to the friendly staff there who helped me through my first few shots on my vacation in Japan.

    Tags
    Shibuya, Harajuku, Three-Cushion, Closed

    This was only one stop from my home on the Yamanote line and became my 'home club' when I worked in Tokyo. I would always try to pop in after work and it was the most friendly place to play three cushion. I played there as 'ルーク' they probably long forgotten me but I still remember them so well and have some of my happiest three cushion memories there, and the thrill of playing pro 米山先生. Is this club closed now, thats so sad?

    Did I play here, maybe not, maybe it was a club in Gotanda long closed down? I have the feeling that some days I would sneak out of work for a long dinner break and pop in for a quick game of 3-cushion. One of the regulars taught me about short angle shots and I still rememebr it- thank you!
